definitions: An extended narrative poem in elevated or dignified language, celebrating the feats of a deity, demigod (heroic epic), other legend or traditional hero.
A series of events considered appropriate to an epic; any work of literature, film, etc. having heroic deeds and adventures as its subject matter.
Of or relating to an epic.
Momentously heroic; grand in scale or character.
A feeling of desire for new and exciting things.
A remarkable occurrence; a striking event.
To risk oneself; to dare to go somewhere or undertake something.

blocks.text: An adventure is a novel and exciting undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky. Adventures may be activities with danger such as traveling, exploring, skydiving, mountain climbing, scuba diving, river rafting, other extreme sports, or, importantly, any other activity that may be new, fresh or difficult and may even lead to failure. Adventure can take many forms beyond the typically described outdoor area. Adventures are often undertaken to create psychological arousal or in order to achieve a greater goal, such as the pursuit of knowledge that can only be obtained by such activities.

images.alt: Lewis Carroll's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland is a well-known example of a fantasized adventure story.
